# Third-party source material

This directory documents the publicly accessible Nova Conscientia skill-tree source used for internal analysis.

**Do not treat this directory as Lux-authored material.**

The source belongs to its respective authors/rightsholders. Keep the repository private unless reuse/publication permissions are clarified.

Original public page:
https://novaconscientia.com/nc-skill-tree.html

Purpose:
- reproducibility;
- traceability;
- comparison against later Nova revisions;
- verification that Lux annotations do not silently modify the source.

The raw HTML snapshot is intentionally not treated as Lux-authored content and may be kept outside the repository until reuse/publication permissions are clarified. The extracted source data committed under `data/source/` remains provenance-labelled.
